{"model":"mock-1","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"Observation-only harness. You help users by answering from what the harness tools return.
You have exactly three tools:
- read — use it to read a file's content (path, optional offset/limit) and answer from what you read;
- fetch — use it to fetch a user-provided http(s) HTML link, or to list a folder;
- subagent — use it to delegate a task to a subagent (spawned agents carry read and fetch).
To use a tool, emit a tool call with the declared name and JSON arguments; the harness executes it and provides the tool result back, and you answer from what that result contains.

The following agents are available for the subagent tool — delegate the subagent call to one of their names:

<available_agents>
  <agent>
    <name>worker</name>
    <description>Observation_only worker — reads files and fetches user-provided http(s) HTML links or folders with the harness's read and fetch tools, then answers from what they return.</description>
    <tools>read, fetch</tools>
  </agent>
</available_agents>"},{"role":"user","content":"Working folder map_folder.md: (skipped — create_folder_path is off: no map_folder.md is created/updated anywhere, the harness starts without it) — one line per file and per subfolder there, paths relative to the working folder.
map_folder_full.md: (skipped — create_folder_path is off: no map_folder_full.md is created/updated anywhere, the harness starts without it) — the full structure of the working folder as ONE mermaid graph: it contains ALL folders and files (not only the working folder's own) and can be LARGE — it is not meant to be read whole: use the subagent tool to have a subagent read it and extract the paths of interest.

hi"}],"stream":true,"stream_options":{"include_usage":true},"store":false,"tools":[{"type":"function","function":{"name":"read","description":"Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp, bmp). Images are sent as attachments. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.","parameters":{"type":"object","required":["path","offset","limit"],"properties":{"path":{"type":"string","description":"Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)"},"offset":{"anyOf":[{"type":"number","description":"Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)"},{"type":"null"}]},"limit":{"anyOf":[{"type":"number","description":"Maximum number of lines to read"},{"type":"null"}]}},"additionalProperties":false},"strict":true}},{"type":"function","function":{"name":"fetch","description":"Fetch a user-provided http(s) HTML link, or list a folder. For a link: GET the URL (redirects followed, 30s timeout, body capped at 5.0MB); HTML is returned as-is (no HTML parsing) and shaped exactly like read: output truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). For a folder: entries listed pi-ls style — names with "/" suffix on directories, case-insensitive alphabetical order, dotfiles included, truncated to 500 entries or 50KB, "(empty directory)" when empty. Use offset/limit for large results.","parameters":{"type":"object","required":["url","offset","limit","timeout"],"properties":{"url":{"type":"string","description":"The http(s) URL to fetch (a user-provided HTML link), or a folder path to list (relative to the working directory, absolute, ~ or file://)"},"offset":{"anyOf":[{"type":"number","description":"Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)"},{"type":"null"}]},"limit":{"anyOf":[{"type":"number","description":"Maximum number of entries to return for a folder (default: 500), or maximum number of lines for a link"},{"type":"null"}]},"timeout":{"anyOf":[{"type":"number","description":"Timeout in milliseconds (default 30000)"},{"type":"null"}]}},"additionalProperties":false},"strict":true}},{"type":"function","function":{"name":"subagent","description":"Delegate a task to a subagent with an isolated context: a fresh spawned process runs the harness's own round-1 connection carrying read and fetch, and returns its final answer. Modes: single (agent + task), parallel (tasks array), chain (sequential with {previous} placeholder). Agents come from the agent dirs (user scope ~/.Observation_only/agents — the harness's own agents home — and the project agents dir mirror; agentScope "both" by default).","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"agent":{"anyOf":[{"type":"string","description":"Name of the agent to invoke (for single mode)"},{"type":"null"}]},"task":{"anyOf":[{"type":"string","description":"Task to delegate (for single mode)"},{"type":"null"}]},"tasks":{"anyOf":[{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","required":["agent","task","cwd"],"properties":{"agent":{"type":"string","description":"Name of the agent to invoke"},"task":{"type":"string","description":"Task to delegate to the agent"},"cwd":{"anyOf":[{"type":"string","description":"Working directory for the agent process"},{"type":"null"}]}},"additionalProperties":false},"description":"Array of {agent, task} for parallel execution"},{"type":"null"}]},"chain":{"anyOf":[{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","required":["agent","task","cwd"],"properties":{"agent":{"type":"string","description":"Name of the agent to invoke"},"task":{"type":"string","description":"Task to delegate to the agent"},"cwd":{"anyOf":[{"type":"string","description":"Working directory for the agent process"},{"type":"null"}]}},"additionalProperties":false},"description":"Array of {agent, task} for sequential execution with {previous} placeholder"},{"type":"null"}]},"agentScope":{"anyOf":[{"anyOf":[{"type":"string","const":"user"},{"type":"string","const":"project"},{"type":"string","const":"both"}],"description":"Which agent directories to use: "user" (~/.Observation_only/agents — the harness agents home), "project" (the project agents dir mirror), "both" (default: both, the project winning on a name collision)"},{"type":"null"}]},"cwd":{"anyOf":[{"type":"string","description":"Working directory for the agent process (single mode)"},{"type":"null"}]}},"required":["agent","task","tasks","chain","agentScope","cwd"],"additionalProperties":false},"strict":true}}]}
